title: Selective upregulation of histamine H3 receptor expression in postmortem dorsolateral prefrontal cortex tissue in compulsive disorders: a pilot study.
evidence_type: peer-reviewed primary secondary analysis of postmortem microarray data; abstract-only extraction
date_caveat: October 29 PubMed/Entrez metadata was absent from previous bounded retrieval. Indexing timestamps lack independently verified timezone; newly retrieved is not newly published.
population: Mixed OCD, OCPD and tic/Tourette diagnostic group versus nonpsychiatric controls. Age, total n and TS-specific n unavailable in inspected abstract.
design: Adjusted regression of bulk DLPFC microarray gene expression. Public source data described by authors; no data files accessed.
covariates: Demographic, postmortem and technical covariates described generally; exact model not available in abstract.
prespecification: HRH3 designated primary by authors; prospective registration not verified. Secondary pathway genes received multiplicity correction.
negative_evidence: No other histamine pathway gene significant after multiple-testing correction; remaining-gene Bayesian analyses favored null models.
precision: No effect coefficient, confidence interval, sample size, age range, prior specification or diagnostic-stratum estimate extracted.
claim_supported: Preliminary bulk-tissue transcript-level association in a diagnostically mixed sample.
claim_not_supported: Tourette-specific mechanism or universal histamine deficit
Receptor protein abundance or receptor function
Causation, disease modification or treatment target validation
Efficacy or safety of histamine-modulating drugs
limitations: Diagnostic heterogeneity and unknown TS subgroup contribution
Bulk tissue cannot identify cell-specific causal processes
Weak Bayesian support and absent precision/prior details
Independent replication and cohort overlap unverified
adverse_events: No treatment tested; no clinical safety estimate.
funding_conflicts: PubMed lists no competing interest; funding not extracted.
cohort_overlap: Underlying dataset accession and overlap with historical transcriptomic cohorts not verified; do not count as independent replication.
access: Official NLM metadata and abstract inspected transiently. No underlying datasets, participant rows or full paper saved.
correction_retraction_check: No linked notice in official PubMed metadata retrieved October 31.
next_verification_task: Before target-level interpretation, obtain lawful participant-free methods/aggregate results: n and diagnostic counts, age, dataset overlap, covariates, coefficient/CI and Bayesian prior; do not access participant data or contact authors.
